Who We Are!

🌍 Africa has the world’s youngest and fastest-growing population. By 2035, the continent is poised to contribute more young people to the global workforce each year than the rest of the world combined.

At Educate! we're obsessed with impact. We leverage iterative learning to build highly scalable youth employment solutions aimed at unlocking the potential of the world’s youngest continent.

Educate! prepares youth in Africa to learn, earn and thrive in today’s economy by:

  1. Introducing an employment-focused school subject into secondary and
  2. Delivering livelihood boot camps for out-of-school youth, with a focus on marginalized rural girls and young women.

To date, more than 850,000+ young people have been meaningfully impacted across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania, driving positive outcomes on income, employment, gender equity, family planning and sexual and reproductive health, and educational attainment.

Educate! is already East Africa’s largest employment and youth skills provider, and we’re on an exciting journey to impact millions more in the years ahead.

Educate! is a team of over 300 largely African staff and 300 volunteer youth mentors. We prioritize building an engaging, fulfilling and growth oriented work environment. 50% of our top 30 leaders have been with us for over 5 years, 10+ alumni have started their own organizations, and 6 current or former team members were Acumen Fund East Africa fellows.

We have been backed by top foundations such as Imaginable Futures, Livelihood Impact Fund, Jack Dorsey’s #startsmall, CIFF and Echidna Giving. Educate! won a 2018 Klaus J. Jacobs Prize and a 2015 WISE Award, and has been highlighted bythe World Bank’s S4YE's Impact Portfolio, an Al Jazeera documentary,BBC, The Brookings Institution as one of 14 case studies on scaling education, and the Gates Foundation as a Goalkeepers Accelerator. In 2022, we received a catalytic investment from philanthropist Mackenzie Scott to scale our systems change work.

Educate!'s long-term vision is to design solutions that measurably impact millions of youth across Africa each year.

Good to note: To Our Awesome Applicants! 🚀💫

We know that incredible candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply!

We’re looking for passionate individuals who believe in our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team—not just those who check every box. We value diversity and strongly encourage women and individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Position Overview

The Implementation Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for Educate!'s program delivery, ensuring high-quality implementation, strong team performance, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement aligned with Educate!'s mission.

What You’ll Do🌟

Team Performance Management

  • Manage and develop a high-performing program team of Program Officers ensuring clarity of expectations, consistent feedback, and continuous skill growth.
  • Drive a strong performance culture, characterized by accountability, ownership, and results, building systems and ways of working that enable teams to execute with consistency and high standards.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and termly planning sessions with team members, addressing performance challenges promptly and constructively.
  • Anticipate staffing needs as the program scales and support recruitment, onboarding, and professional development, ensuring strong succession planning and talent development through the YET and round robin while maintaining a database of backup for DOs
  • Collaborate with PRIS to identify team capacity gaps and co-design training and coaching sessions for Program Officers and mentors to support high-quality performance and implementation.

Program Strategic Implementation

  • Own the end-to-end strategic implementation of the Educate! Experience product in your region, developing and maintaining team and department goals that ensure clarity of priorities and alignment across the program team, in collaboration with the Head of Program Implementation and other Implementation Managers.
  • Translate organizational strategy into a calendar of activities reflecting actionable termly and monthly plans, co-leading planning and execution cycles by defining priorities, setting targets, tracking progress weekly, and proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks in line with Educate!'s quality standards.
  • Use dashboards and data insights to drive decision-making, refine implementation strategies, and hold teams accountable to targets, embedding a culture of data-driven management through reports, sprint reviews, and implementation progress meetings.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce handbooks, procedures, tools, systems, and workflows that enable consistent and high-quality execution in a rapidly growing and evolving environment.
  • Facilitate and document feedback on program implementation through retrospectives, termly reviews, and weekly check-ins, using insights to drive continuous improvement and inform strategy.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication across the program team, ensuring all team members have the information, training, materials, and resources required to deliver effectively.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders across product, design, HR, performance metrics, country operations, and finance to ensure alignment, resolve dependencies, and support smooth program implementation at scale.
  • Proactively identify and solve problems that may hamper program delivery, proposing and implementing solutions in a timely manner, and conducting field visits to assess fidelity, performance, and school experience across your region.
  • Co-create mentor recruitment strategies with the Field Operations Manager and guide Program Officers in implementation, ensuring culturally fit mentors are hired and their performance managed by Program Officers.

Team Culture Management

  • Model Educate!'s cultural tenets daily by fostering an environment of openness, trust, collaboration, and high expectations, and consistently assess people based on both work output and how the work gets done.
  • Build a positive, inclusive, high-performance team culture that supports innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and encourage culture initiatives such as recognition, shout-outs, and team-defined ways of working.
  • Encourage open communication, constructive feedback, and team participation in decision-making, proactively addressing issues related to morale, conflict, and workload balance before they escalate.
  • Lead termly team culture audits to identify areas of strength and improvement, and partner with the Head of Program Implementation to address any identified issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain data integrity standards and develop the same culture of accuracy, accountability, and ownership across field teams.
  • Create psychological safety within the team by actively mining for dissent, welcoming divergent thinking, and ensuring all team members feel heard, valued, and safe to speak up.
  • Conduct proactive pulse checks with individual team members to understand their wellbeing, job satisfaction, and any emerging concerns, and follow up on feedback shared.

Finance and Budget Management

  • Lead the development and management of program budgets, ensuring efficient allocation aligned to program priorities with all activities accounted for, including staff development, training, and operational costs.
  • Maintain rigorous financial controls by reviewing and approving all program-related requisitions and accountabilities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and value for money.
  • Conduct monthly and quarterly BvAs and use insights to inform strategic decisions, optimize spending, and ensure continuous alignment between budget and implementation realities.
  • Ensure all financial processes are documented, standardized, and audit-ready as the program grows to scale.
  • Maintain financial fiduciary responsibility by identifying areas of fraud or loopholes in finance systems and tools, and promptly escalate findings to the Head of Program Implementation and Finance Manager.
  • Manage cash flow planning by projecting financial needs in advance and communicating proactively with the finance team and field teams to ensure funds are requested and disbursed on time.
  • Build the team's capacity to own budget decisions, ensuring Program Officers and DOs understand financial accountability expectations and adhere to reporting submission timelines.
  • Maintain and update common costs regularly, ensuring teams are aware of and consistently apply them, and hold teams accountable for any deviations.
  • Ensure all program-related expenditures represent value for money and are aligned with Educate!'s cost management principles of scalability, sustainability, and organizational culture fit.

Who You Are 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Development Studies, Social Sciences or related relevant field.
  • Minimum 5 years of program management experience ideally in education or youth development.
  • Proven leadership and supervisory skills with experience managing diverse teams.
  • Strong communication, coordination, stakeholder management, and partnership-building abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data for decision-making and program improvement.
  • Fits our Five Culture Tenets (see What is Educate! About? below); Learn more by looking at Educate!’s culture deck here

What We Offer

  • A vibrant, mission-driven environment with a supportive and fun team.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Competitive benefits based on location
  • Flexibility—hybrid work environment (location dependent)
  • Learning & growth opportunities
  • This is a Fixed term contract with a possibility of extension based on performance

Our Culture & Tenets(Values) 🌱

We’re ambitious. Are you? Educate! is growing fast, so new opportunities are opening up and expanding all the time. We’re inspired by people with drive, and we love to help them reach their full potential. We expect everyone at Educate! to contribute above and beyond their job description, grow their skills, and advance their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey of their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey.

  1. We put Youth First, Impact-Obsessed - We are purpose-driven, focused on impact, and prioritize what truly matters. We listen to youth, design our efforts around their needs, and ensure every dollar creates transformative experiences they value.
  2. We Exceed Expectations - We take pride in going above and beyond to achieve the best results—proactively identifying problems and seeking solutions without waiting or stopping at what's requested.
  3. We Are Always Learning - We are committed to seeking and applying new knowledge and ideas. We stay open-minded and continuously try new things, experiment, grow, and improve. We invest in learning for ourselves and our teams.
  4. We are One Team, Many Views - We value all individuals, believe diverse ideas and open dialogue drive excellence, foster a supportive and respectful environment where everyone can freely express themselves. We work as one team and prioritize the organization's mission over personal or team interests.
  5. We have the Startup Mindset - We innovate relentlessly to grow our impact, we never think “we have arrived” or “we’re done.”We constantly challenge the status quo, embrace change, and move quickly toward our vision. Unafraid of failure, we question anything that hinders progress.

Every person at Educate! — from interns to the executive director — is evaluated by how they live up to these five cultural tenets. They are at the core of how we achieve our mission and why we work as well as we do. Educate is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all who interact in our community. In creating this environment, we encourage people from a variety of cultures, backgrounds and life experiences to join our diverse team.

We’re committed to ensuring all candidates are screened for child and youth safety. As part of the process, candidates must successfully complete our standard background verification and safeguarding review in accordance with local legal standards. Educate! reserves the right to withdraw an offer of employment if any screening results indicate potential risks to youth.
